chapter_title: Concerning Four Hunters of Light and Four of Darkn
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 The Hunters


---


**
¶2**


The first
 seeking
 principle
 is the pr
imal Divine
 Humanity
 that
 proceeded
 from the Infinite.
 It
 descended into the five genera of evil and
 falsity,
 and
 confront
ed and
 seized
 the enmity of hell
 against heaven
,
 extending
 its divine
 influence over every
 derivative falsity born
 of those
 ev
ils. The
 doctrine
 by which it passes
 through these
 states
 consists of the
 four divine qualities proce
eding from it
, which clothe its essential being
 as external truths encomp
assing its
 in
most
 nature. The realm
 through which it moves
 is the whole domain of evil
 and falsity.
 Its means
 of capturing and restraining what
 opp
oses it
 are the divine powers
 that
 proceed from it.

---


**¶3**

The
 second
 seeking principle is the
 Mediating Divine Eman
ation.
 By the
 appearance of divine wisdom,
 which it
 revealed even
 into
 the lowest spiritual states, it sought
 to recover all good
 and truth dispersed and
 held
 capt
ive throughout
 creation. Its means
 of gathering is the very manifestation of
 divine truth itself
 —
 the form
 of
 wisdom
 made
 visible
 —
 which
 extends
 throughout
 the whole of created spiritual life
 and
 draws
 all capt
ive good
 into
 itself by
 lik
eness. The
 doctrine
 that
 carries
 it is composed
 wholly
 of pure wisdom.
 The domain
 it
 traverses is the tot
ality of spiritual states,
 and everything
 recovered
 by
 its influence
 is drawn
 toward
 the
 glory
 of that
 same
 manif
ested truth
.

---

**¶5
**

The fourth seeking principle is the
 great interior
 Providence
 that
 dwells within the sphere
 encomp
assing all spiritual states
,
 all
 of
 which are pres
ently contained within it. Yet
 at the final
 consummation,
 when every
 created
 spiritual state is
 dissolved into its
 ess
entials
, this living Providence
 will gather into
 itself every
 particle
 of recovered
 good
 and form
 it into the ultimate
 perf
ected spiritual humanity
 —
 the Last Image
 of the Divine-
Human
 form
. Its means of gathering is the Divine
 Proceeding itself —
 the Living
 Spirit —
 because
 through that
 Spirit it seeks out every
 remn
ant of wisdom
 and life
 dispersed throughout all
 things
, and incorpor
ates what
 it recovers into its own
 manif
ested form. The doctrine by
 which it moves
 through
 these states is natural
 truth illuminated from within — a transl
ucent medium
 through
 which it passes among
 the five
 fundamental
 spiritual
 substances of created life. The divine
 love that at
 last
 cons
umes every
 false
 doc
trinal system constructed
 by evil
 —
 that
 love operates
 within
 its
 gathering
 influence
,
 wherein
 all
 recovered
 wisdom
 and all
 recovered life
 r
eside.
 By
 this
 means it liber
ates and
 frees the
 capt
ive good
 from every bond of
 falsity and every
 f
etter of evil.

---

**
¶8**

The first
 counter
-principle
 of
 pursuit
 is the ruling
 power
 of hell
 —
 the sovereign
 fals
ity that sought
 to capture the interior spiritual life of humanity
 from
 the very
 origin
 of the created
 order
. Its means of ensnaring is
 self-love and concupiscence
, which it
 has
 imposed upon the living
 soul,
 ent
angling the
 whole
 interior
 spiritual life through every derivative form of evil
 influence proce
eding from it.


---

**¶9**


The second
 counter-principle is the inf
ernal deliber
ation —
 the evil
 intelligence
 that dw
ells within the inter
iors of the
 natural
 mind
 —
 which
 seeks
 to interc
ept every
 truth
 and
 good that rises from natural
 understanding toward spiritual understanding.
 It
 binds ascending
 truths with
 its own
 persu
asions, which count
erf
eit genuine
 elevation
 by
 drawing
 them into seemingly celest
ial but actually inv
erted states. Its means of capture
 operates
 across
 the full range of spiritual life
, se
izing what ascends from
 the deep
est obsc
urity and
 di
verting it before
 it reaches
 genuine
 heights
.

erts the very

---

**¶10
**

The third counter-principle is
 conc
upiscence itself
 — naked
 selfish desire —
 which operates
 through every capacity of the proprium,
 moving
 within
 every natural and
 bod
ily faculty
.
 It
 en
cl
oses the interior
 spiritual lives
 of
 human
 beings within the
 external forms
 of the
 merely
 natural self
, impris
oning the
 living
 soul
 within the body
 of
 its
 own
 appet
ites.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first hunter is the First Man who was sent from the greatness. He threw himself down to the five storehouses of Darkness, he caught and siezed the enmity [of Darkness against the Light;] his net also [he spread] out over all the children of Darkness [and ensnared them]. His ship is his four sons who are swathed over his body. The sea is the land of Darkness [in which he hunts]; his net is [his light] and his powers.

The second hunter is the Third Ambassador. This one, for by his light image, which he revealed to the depths below, he hunted after the entire light that is in all things; as it is established in them. His net is his light image, [which he cast over] the whole universe and took it prisoner, to this likeness [of his glory. His] ship is his light ship. [The sea] is the universe[, and those things] which were hunted after by his net [are gathered to] his [glorious] image.

The first hunter is the King of they who belong to the Darkness, who hunted after the living soul with his net at the beginning of the worlds. His net is his fire and his lust that he has put upon the living soul, with which he has entangled it [and bound it], through all his powers.

[The] second hunter is the evil counsel that lives in [the flesh,] that hunts after the light [and the life,] and [draws them] up from [the depths of] the earths to heaven. It binds them with its powers, which bring them to the heavenly worlds above. Its net is [its deceit and its guile,] whereby they are drawn up from the abyss [to the heig]hts.

The third hunter is lust [that] walks in every power of the flesh that walks [and moves] in the [world among] the living souls [and encloses] them in its bodies, which [are the bonds and fetters of its desire].

The fourth hunter is the great counsel that [...] that lives in the circuit [...] entire universe in it today. Yet, at the end, in the dissolution of the universe, this very counsel of life will gather itself in and sculpt its soul in the Last Statue. Its net is its Living Spirit, because with its Spirit it can hunt after the light and the life that is in all things; and build it upon its body. Its ship, in which it is established, is this light cloud whereby it itself travels in the five elements [...], the great fire that will burn all the buildings of [... ...] in its net is the light and the life. It can rescue and free it from all bonds and fetters.
